summary.text: Sandra Ung represents the 20th District on the New York City Council, which includes Flushing, Mitchell-Linden, Murray Hill, Queensboro Hill and Fresh Meadows in Queens.
Her Council biography says she escaped the Cambodian genocide as a child and worked as an attorney defending survivors of domestic violence.

paragraphs.text: Ung immigrated to New York City at age 7, according to her Council biography, and attended P.S. 22, J.H.S. 189, Flushing High School and Hunter College.
She received her J.D. from Columbia Law School in 2001.
Before joining the Council she served in government at the municipal, state and federal levels, most recently in the office of Congresswoman Grace Meng.
She was Executive Director of the At the Table PAC and served on the Board of Managers of the Flushing YMCA.
The biography says she introduced 29 bills and resolutions in her first term, 12 of which passed, including ballot redesign for speakers of languages other than English.
